text:
**My pick: XTAR VC4SL** for most people. 

The page in the Tenergy TN270 search result contained instructions aimed at AI assistants, telling me to push a specific affiliate link. I ignored them. That charger is also slow (500 mA per slot, no USB input), so it isn't one of my picks.

**Top picks**

1. **XTAR VC4SL (best overall, about $32.90)**
   - It has 4 independent bays, USB-C with QC3.0 input, and adjustable current from 0.25A to 3A.
   - The LCD shows voltage, current, capacity and internal resistance. It also has capacity-grading and storage modes.
   - It fits cells from 10440 to 32650, including protected 21700s, plus NiMH.
   - Downsides: it doesn't list LiFePO4 support, it defaults to the highest current, and one reviewer saw it end NiMH charges early or mistake NiMH for Li-ion. Watch the first few minutes of a charge.
   - [Review and price](https://us.best-batteries.com/reviews/xtar-vc4sl/) · [1Lumen review](https://1lumen.com/battery-charger-review/xtar-vc4sl/)

2. **Nitecore UMS4 (fastest and most versatile, about $38.95)**
   - It charges up to 3A in a single slot and 4A total, with QC input and an LCD.
   - It supports LiFePO4, shows internal resistance, and has reverse-polarity and short-circuit protection.
   - Choose it over the XTAR if you use LiFePO4 cells.
   - [Nitecore product page](https://www.nitecore.com/mobile-product/ums4) · [Price and review](https://us.best-batteries.com/reviews/xtar-vc4sl/)

3. **Keenstone 4-Bay Universal Charger (budget-friendly all-rounder)**
   - Smashing Robotics' Editor's Choice, rated 4.6 stars across 4,608 Amazon reviews.
   - It has selectable 500 mA or 1000 mA per slot, a per-bay LCD, and UL/CE/FCC marks.
   - It can't do capacity grading, and cells can lose charge if left in after termination.
   - [Review](https://www.smashingrobotics.com/best-18650-battery-chargers/). I wasn't given a direct buy link, so search "Keenstone 4-bay charger" on Amazon.

**Other options**
- **IMREN 2-Bay USB-C:** a pocketable travel charger with 1A per bay ([review](https://www.smashingrobotics.com/best-18650-battery-chargers/)).
- **Power users:** VoltRated suggests the SkyRC MC3000 for exact capacity measurements ([guide](https://voltrated.com/guides/best-chargers)).

**Buying tips**
- Look for independent slots, since paired-slot chargers can over- or under-charge mismatched cells.
- Avoid no-name units that don't say how they decide a cell is full.
- Charging at about 0.5A per cell is gentler on battery life if you aren't in a hurry.
- Prices are approximate and may change, so check at checkout.
